notes.title: Ruya: Ascension
notes.content:
Game Announcement!

It's been 7 years since Miracle Tea released the original Ruya and we're celebrating this anniversary by announcing a brand new game! Our team has been busy working on Ruya: Ascension, a trippy sequel to the original puzzle game!

Wishlist Ruya: Ascension Here!

Community

Join us on Discord to stay up to date with our  development and tell us what you think so far!

- Miracle Tea

notes.title: Small Update
notes.content:
Been a while since we've updated Ruya here, so we're starting off with a small update just by enabling Steam's Cloud Save, enjoy!

We've got some cool stuff in the works related to Ruya, so keep your eyes peeled.

- Miracle Tea
